method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Gets the controller root model and requests create(path,true). It does not explicitly return the created child. Requests setSessionMode on the exact supplied menu receiver with the supplied mode. Returns getSessionMode from the supplied receiver. Saves the current clip_over handler as _originalClipOver, then installs an event closure. Delivery sets the supplied state only when no nextClip exists and the element is not already in it, then always invokes the saved handler. There is no nil guard on the original handler or restoration shown. Sets table[key]=true unless the key equals hash_0. It does not test nil or empty-string independently. Returns true for either explicit Russian language enum, false for all other loc_language values. The dvar is read twice on the first comparison path. Captures the global showBuildInfo value, writes captured value minus one, then installs an original-second close callback restoring that captured value. Restoration occurs only if close invokes the callback; no missing-model guard, stacking fix or lifetime repair is present.
